description: Defines classes for binary serialization and deserialization of simple types, including BinaryInputStream and BinaryOutputStream, with methods for reading and writing fundamental types, enums, strings, and vectors.

classes.name: BinaryInputStream
classes.description: Provides methods for reading various data types from a binary data buffer.

classes.name: BinaryOutputStream
classes.description: Provides methods for writing various data types to a binary data buffer.

methods.name: readInt
methods.description: Reads an integer of specified type from the stream.

methods.name: readIntVector
methods.description: Reads a vector of integers from the stream.

methods.name: readEnum
methods.description: Reads an enum value from the stream.

methods.name: readBool
methods.description: Reads a boolean value from the stream.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a string from the stream.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Writes an integer of specified type to the stream.

methods.name: writeIntOrNegOne
methods.description: Writes an integer or -1 to the stream.

methods.name: writeIntVector
methods.description: Writes a vector of integers to the stream.

methods.name: writeEnum
methods.description: Writes an enum value to the stream.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string to the stream.
